verdict.rationale: The state's Business Gateway landing page says up front that sign-in runs on a single OHID credential and points to log-in and getting-started tips, so the credential layer is disclosed before a founder begins. The evidence does not list the actual account-creation or identity-proofing steps. It also does not tie the OHID requirement to Secretary of State business filings on Ohio Business Central, whose own pages could not be read. Missing for 10: an explicit published list of account, credential and identity-proofing steps for SOS business filings; evidence that these are stated before the flow starts rather than discovered mid-flow; independent or hands-on corroboration.
